verses.pali: “Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā pañca dhamme bhāveti, pañca dhamme bahulīkaroti, tassa dvinnaṁ phalānaṁ aññataraṁ phalaṁ pāṭikaṅkhaṁ—
verses.english: “Mendicants, any monk or nun who develops and cultivates five qualities can expect one of two results:

verses.pali: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā.
verses.english: enlightenment in this very life, or if there’s residue left behind, non-return.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti,
verses.english: A mendicant develops the basis of psychic power that has immersion due to enthusiasm, and active effort …
A mendicant develops the basis of psychic power that has immersion due to energy, and active effort …
A mendicant develops the basis of psychic power that has immersion due to mental development, and active effort …
A mendicant develops the basis of psychic power that has immersion due to inquiry, and active effort.
And the fifth is sheer vigor.

verses.pali: Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime pañca dhamme bhāveti, ime pañca dhamme bahulīkaroti, tassa dvinnaṁ phalānaṁ aññataraṁ phalaṁ pāṭikaṅkhaṁ—
verses.english: Any monk or nun who develops and cultivates these five qualities can expect one of two results:

verses.pali: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā”ti.
verses.english: enlightenment in this very life, or if there’s residue left behind, non-return.”
